children: Lenskart Solutions shares jumped up to 5 percent on Monday after Nomura initiated coverage on the stock with a 'buy' recommendation and a target price of Rs 888 per share, indicating an upside of nearly 40 percent from its previous close.
The stock hit an intraday high of Rs 666.90 per share on the NSE, up 5 percent.
The target price of Rs 888 is the highest among the 23 analysts covering the stock, reported CNBC-TV18.
Nomura said Lenskart has transformed from a challenger into a market leader in India's highly customised, fragmented and unorganised prescription eyewear category.
The brokerage said the company has a market share of 5 percent, twice that of the number two player.
Strong buying interest in the stock also came amid the MSCI rejig, with Lenskart Solutions set to enter the MSCI India Standard Index.
Lenskart Solutions is likely to have a weight of 0.3 percent in the index, attracting an estimated USD 352 million in passive inflows.
The expected buying is equivalent to about 57 million shares, or around 13 times the company's average trading volume.
The stock has risen 15 percent in the last one month and has extended its year-to-date gain to 50 percent.

title: Lenskart shares jump up to 5% as Nomura initiates coverage, sees 40% upside
